snippet.title: Riddles & Sieges - Steam Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Riddles & Sieges is coming to Steam in April!
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/23...

Riddles & Sieges is a medieval puzzle game where you use old siege weapons to solve puzzles. Your goal is to destroy the castle and for that you are given sets of different buildings with their own quirks and timings.
